QuestInfo.name: Eavesdropping for Fun and Profit
QuestInfo.0: I tried to prepare myself for whatever might come up, but I'm not sure what come next, honestly. At times like these, there's only one thing to do...
QuestInfo.1: It's time for 'Operation Slow-and-Steady!' Let's hide in the back of the tavern and eavesdrop on what the patrons are talking about.
QuestInfo.2: As you were eavesdropping, the tavern-goer got a fishbone caught in his throat, preventing him from continuing to tell his story.
